title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TE RRUGA MINE PEZA !
description_sq:
Shitet apartament vetem pak minuta larg qendres se Tiranes, ne katin e katert te nje ndertimi ekzistues, pa ashensor. Apartamenti shtrihet ne nje siperfaqe prej 73 metrash katror dhe i eshte nenshtruar nje rinovimi total duke perfshire edhe tavane te varur.
Organizohet ne 1 dhome ndenje, dhome gatimi me vete, dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet me ajrosje natyrale. Ka orientim shume te mire, lindje perendim, duke ofruar drite gjate gjithe dites.
Vendodhja shume e mire, rrethuar me cerdhe, shkolla dhe nje seri sherbimesh te tjera te nevojshme per nje familje.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE ON MINE PEZA STREET!
description_en: Apartment for sale just a few minutes from the center of Tirana, on the fourth floor of an existing building, without elevator. The apartment covers an area of ​​73 square meters and has undergone a total renovation, including suspended ceilings. It is organized in 1 living room, separate kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with natural ventilation. It has a very good orientation, east-west, offering light throughout the day. Very good location, surrounded by nurseries, schools and a series of other services necessary for a family. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
